viewport_notes: mobile: 1-2 col grid, cards don't overflow. desktop: 3-4 col grid, even gutters.

checks.rule: no spacing collisions or overlapping elements; nothing wraps or overflows the viewport (flex rows, long text); typography cascade intact (no wrong font/size/weight bleeding into a section); if the surface renders dark, text stays readable
the collection renders REAL product cards — NOT '0 products / No products found' (an empty/unpopulated collection is broken)
cards align to a consistent grid; equal heights; same image aspect ratio; even gutters
no sideways scroll; cards don't overflow
collection title is intentional (not a default like 'Automated Collection'); cards show image+title+price legibly
filters/sort + consent chrome on-brand; not covering the grid
intentional premium per the niche scorecard

the collection title and any banner headline stay visually contiguous on EVERY viewport — no decorative rule/divider/dash/border-pseudo-element splits a headline phrase into disconnected pieces (watch the mobile breakpoint).
the collection banner image keeps its subject at EVERY viewport — the mobile crop is meaningful, never a blank/subject-less patch from a desktop image cropped by the mobile container.

sources: store catalog (porter — collection must be populated)
